label: PR + St. John · Nov 7–14
summary: 2 nights Old San Juan, then fly to St. Thomas and ferry to St. John: 5 nights by Virgin Islands National Park. ~$2,107 pp.
title: Old San Juan + St. John: Virgin Islands National Park
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Nov 7 → LAX **Sat Nov 14**. 2 nights Puerto Rico, 5 nights St. John (US Virgin Islands).
- **Route (1 real move):** Old San Juan 2n → fly SJU→STT Mon Nov 9 → ferry to Cruz Bay, St. John 5n → Sat Nov 14 ferry + flight STT→SJU, home ~17:00.
- **Flights:** LAX–SJU round trip ~$350, plus two separate STT↔SJU hops (~35–40m each).
- **National park:** ~60% of St. John is Virgin Islands National Park: Trunk Bay snorkel trail, Maho Bay turtles, Waterlemon Cay, Annaberg ruins, Reef Bay petroglyphs.
- **Slow days:** Sun Nov 8 (Old San Juan), Thu Nov 12 and Fri Nov 13 (St. John).
- **Getting around:** walk + safari taxis; jeep 1 day (Nov 11). Drive on the left.
- **Not here:** El Yunque, Vieques bio bay (St. John has none).
- **Pace:** longest travel day Mon Nov 9 (~4h door to door). ~$2,107 pp.

itinerary.title: Fly to Puerto Rico
itinerary.details: Early 1-stop (via MIA/CLT/DFW/ATL/JFK). LAX ~06:00–08:00 → SJU ~18:00–21:00 (+4h clock). Taxi 20m to Old San Juan. Street food, sleep in tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Slow day in Old San Juan
itinerary.details: Sleep in after the flight. Late breakfast. ~11:00 El Morro (one ~$10 fee covers San Cristóbal too), Paseo del Morro walk. Lunch, siesta. Late afternoon: San Cristóbal or just the blue streets, Paseo de la Princesa at sunset. No driving, no packing.

itinerary.location: San Juan → St. Thomas → St. John
itinerary.title: Hop to St. John
itinerary.details: ~08:30 taxi 20m to SJU. JetBlue or Cape Air ~10:00, ~35–40m to St. Thomas (STT). Taxi ~30–40m to Red Hook (per-person fares, + bags). Ferry on the hour, 20m to Cruz Bay. Lunch, check in. Late afternoon: Lind Point Trail (~1.1 mi) to Honeymoon Beach for a first swim. Sunset in Cruz Bay.
itinerary.overnight: Cruz Bay, St. John – St. John Inn

itinerary.title: Trunk Bay and Cinnamon Bay
itinerary.details: Safari taxi ~08:30 to Trunk Bay ($5 pp): underwater snorkel trail with signs. Go early, before cruise-day crowds from St. Thomas. Taxi or walk on to Cinnamon Bay: sugar-mill ruins loop, easy snorkel off the point. Lunch at the beach. Back by mid-afternoon; siesta.
itinerary.overnight: Cruz Bay, St. John – St. John Inn

itinerary.title: Jeep day: turtles and the best reef
itinerary.details: Pick up a jeep in Cruz Bay ~08:00 (drive on the LEFT). ~08:30 Maho Bay: shallow seagrass, sea turtles very likely. ~10:30 Annaberg sugar-mill ruins (free). Leinster Bay trail ~0.8 mi to Waterlemon Cay: best snorkel on the island (turtles, rays, starfish). Current on the far side of the cay: stay close in. Late lunch in Coral Bay. Back over Centerline Road overlooks. Return jeep.
itinerary.overnight: Cruz Bay, St. John – St. John Inn

itinerary.title: Slow day
itinerary.details: Sleep in. Beach of choice (Honeymoon or Salomon via Lind Point, or taxi back to Maho). Optional morning hike: Reef Bay Trail from Centerline Road, ~2.2 mi downhill to the Taíno petroglyphs and sugar-mill ruins, steep climb back (~3–4h; taxi to/from trailhead). Siesta. Sunset dinner in Cruz Bay.
itinerary.overnight: Cruz Bay, St. John – St. John Inn

itinerary.title: Last beach day, pack
itinerary.details: Easy morning swim (or Cinnamon/Maho again by safari taxi). Early dinner, pack. Early night: tomorrow starts ~06:30. Or take the isla-verde-last-night option: fly to SJU this afternoon and sleep by the airport.
itinerary.overnight: Cruz Bay, St. John – St. John Inn

itinerary.location: St. John → St. Thomas → San Juan → Los Angeles
itinerary.title: Home via San Juan
itinerary.details: 07:00 ferry Cruz Bay → Red Hook (20m). Taxi ~35m to STT. Clear CBP (US customs/agriculture check before boarding; passport easiest). ~10:45–11:30 Cape Air or JetBlue to SJU (~35m), land ~noon. ~5h buffer. Lunch at the airport. ~17:00 flight home, 1 stop, lands LAX late night (−4h clock).

practical:
## Entry
- US citizens: no passport needed for PR or USVI. **But** flying USVI → PR/mainland you clear **CBP at STT** before boarding (USVI is outside US customs). Passport easiest; else REAL ID + certified birth certificate.
- Duty-free allowance in USVI ($1,600 pp) if shopping.

## Flights
- LAX–SJU round trip (~$350): ~1 stop each way. Return ~17:00 SJU lands LAX late night.
- SJU ↔ STT: JetBlue (A320, bags extra) or Cape Air (9-seat Cessna, ~12+/day each way, weight limits). ~35–40m.
- **Separate tickets:** the airline won't protect the SJU connection. Nov 14 plan gives ~5h buffer; Cape Air runs often enough to rebook. Bags: re-check at SJU.
- Ask: is a multi-city LAX→SJU, STT→LAX (AA via MIA/CLT) close to $350 + $120? That removes the Nov 14 hop.
- PR and USVI = AST (UTC−4). LA = PST after Nov 1: **+4h**.

## St. Thomas → St. John
- STT airport → Red Hook: open-air taxis, fixed per-person fares + bag fee. ~30–40m.
- Red Hook ↔ Cruz Bay passenger ferry: hourly on the hour, ~20m, $8.15 pp one way (non-resident) + ~$4/bag. Cash/card at window.
- Also Charlotte Amalie ↔ Cruz Bay ferry (~45m, fewer runs): closer to STT but longer boat.
- Car barge Red Hook ↔ Cruz Bay (~$65/car one way) only if renting on St. Thomas. Rent on St. John instead.

## On St. John
- Safari taxis (open trucks) from Cruz Bay dock: per-person fares to Trunk, Cinnamon, Maho. Fewer after ~16:00; ask driver for pickup time.
- Jeep: book ahead (small fleet). **Drive on the LEFT**, US-style cars. Steep, winding roads; donkeys and goats on road.
- Park entry free; Trunk Bay $5 pp. No lifeguards most beaches.
- ATMs in Cruz Bay only. Groceries: Starfish Market.

## Snorkel
- Best: Waterlemon Cay (current on far side), Maho (turtles, seagrass, very calm), Trunk Bay trail (crowded on cruise days), Cinnamon point, Honeymoon.
- Nov = north swell season: north shore can get waves; Salt Pond / Coral Bay side calmer.
- Reef-safe (mineral) sunscreen or rash guard. Don't touch coral or turtles.
- Water ~28°C: no wetsuit.

## Weather
- Highs ~29°C/84°F. Short showers. Hurricane season ends Nov 30: watch NHC; free-cancel bookings.

## Money
- USD. St. John ~30% pricier than PR (food, rooms). Tip 15–20%; taxi drivers ~$1–2/bag.

## Hotel notes
- USVI hotel room tax 12.5%. Small inns usually no resort fee.
- Rates are early snapshots; Nov is shoulder season. Take refundable rates; recheck ~2 weeks out.

fatigue_check:
Door-to-door travel per day:
- Nov 7 | 1-stop flight ~9h30 + 20m taxi | long-haul (daytime)
- Nov 8 | none | rest
- Nov 9 | 20m taxi + ~1h early + 40m flight + 35m taxi + ~20m wait + 20m ferry | medium (~4h)
- Nov 10 | safari taxis 15m + 20m | light
- Nov 11 | jeep hops 10–25m, ~1h30 total | light
- Nov 12 | none (optional taxi to Reef Bay) | rest
- Nov 13 | none | rest
- Nov 14 | 20m ferry + 35m taxi + CBP + 40m flight + ~5h SJU wait + ~10h flight | long

Rules:
- **No back-to-back medium days:** met.
- **Rest after the flight:** Nov 8.
- **Slow days mid-trip:** Nov 12–13.
- Only 1 hotel change in 7 nights.
- Weak spot: Nov 14 chains ferry, taxi, customs, two flights. Isla Verde last night option removes it (−$32 pp).
